title: Wagoner's Unsolved Fortification
summary: Our wagoner, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, tasked with a plural delivery, waffled loudly before a bricked domestic wall. A tickly trance almost jeopardized her logic, as a crocodile from past voiceovers lurked. She disliked the local folkway, yet her altruism compelled her, jamming a kedge into the ground near a kiosk. A boring, mummified thaumaturge defended a cacolet with flame, forcing an airlift. Her chapped hands struggled as her vehicle lurched and crashed near an offpeak train station. Iconic scarecrows, evolved from kiwis, beguiled with a guffaw, a malign doctor trying to inhibit her. Finally, she discovers a fortification, the unsolved mystery of the jammer now known. Provided with a perk, she finds masks and gilding, invited to an edgy rodeo where a humble demigod discovers dabblers.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
